They are visually distinct from other types of Lizalfos due to their red and orange coloration. They most commonly reside in the [[Gerudo Desert]] and [[Eldin Canyon]], though they have also been spotted in certain areas of [[Akkala]]. Like other Lizalfos, Fire-Breath Lizalfos are also capable of disguising themselves to blend in with their surroundings. In addition to the agility typical of Lizalfos, Fire-Breath Lizalfos can breathe a stream of [[Fire]]. Hitting them with [[Ice]]-based attack, however, will result in them being instantly defeated. If they are defeated, Fire-Breath Lizalfos will drop [[Lizalfos Talon]]s, [[Lizalfos Horn]]s, and [[Red Lizalfos Tail]]s. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Fire-Breath Lizalfos |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Red Lizalfos Tail | 1 | 100 % |- | Lizalfos Talon | 2 | 100 % |- | Lizalfos Horn | 1 | 100 % }} |- | FireArrow | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Fire Arrow x5 | 1 | 50 % |- | Red Lizalfos Tail | 1 | 50 % |- | Lizalfos Horn | 1
